title: Offence of Zina Enforcement of Hudood Amendment Act 1997

sections.shortTitle: Offence of Zina Enforcement of Hudood Amendment Act 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 1997
ACT VI OF 1997
OFFENCE OF ZINA (ENFORCEMENT OF
HUDOOD) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act further to amend the Offence
of Zina (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 21st April, 1997]
The following Act of Majlis‑e‑Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 16th April, 1997, is
hereby published for general information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Offence of Zina (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance, 1979 (VII of
1979), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.--‑(1) This Act may be called
the Offence of Zina (Enforcement of Hudood) (Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 10, Ordinance VII of 1979

ACT VI OF 1997
ACT VI OF 1997
OFFENCE OF ZINA (ENFORCEMENT OF
HUDOOD) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act further to amend the Offence
of Zina (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 21st April, 1997]
The following Act of Majlis‑e‑Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 16th April, 1997, is
hereby published for general information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Offence of Zina (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance, 1979 (VII of
1979), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 10,
Ordinance VII of 1979.‑‑In the Offence of Zina (Enforcement of Hudood) Ordinance,
1979, in section 10‑‑
(i) in subsection (3) for the word
"Whoever" the words, bracket, figure and comma "Subject to the
subsection (4), whoever" shall be substituted; and
(ii) after subsection (3) amended as
aforesaid the following new subsection shall be added, namely:‑‑
"(4) When Zina‑bil‑Jabr
liable to Tazir is committed by two or more persons in furtherance of common
intention of all, each of such person shall be punished with death.".
